freshness.volatility_notes: Public demo policy and availability can change; review before distribution beyond personal use.

license.usage_notes: Only short metadata and a paraphrase are retained; source terms for the hosted demo should be checked before wider distribution.

confidence.rationale: The Valhalla project's own README describes the public demo, fair-use rate limits, and identifying-client guidance.

claims.claim: FOSSGIS hosts a public Valhalla demo governed by fair-use rate limits; apps requesting routes for end users are asked to identify the client with X-Client-Id and contact the project through GitHub Discussions.
The cited public-demo guidance gives no per-call price or uptime guarantee.
claims.notes: Absence of a listed price is not a promise that service terms will remain unchanged.
